title: Seacrest Beach "BeachHouse44" 44 Brenda Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:-Walk to Alys and Rosemary Beach Shopping and Restaurants-Easy Access to New Publix Grocery/Wine (5 min)-Comfortable Parking for 10+ Vehicles-Large Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $50 per day**-WiFi Internet Premium Speed Package-Multiple TVs including Samsung “The Frame” TVs-Advanced Voice Smoke and CO Detection and Alert System-Instant Hot Water System- Pool table- Grill- 6 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: An elegant 7-bedroom, 7-bathroom home with accommodations for 24 guests in the main house and carriage house. Notable features include a private pool, oversized lot, outdoor entertaining area, pool table, multiple living areas, a detached carriage house, and its prime location to the Gulf! Comes standard with 6 adult bikes and a 6 seat Low-Speed Vehicle for personal use.The first floor of the home warmly invites guests inside to the gathering space with a decor and presence curated by a renowned designer for its breathtaking balance of sophistication and coastal modern minimalism. Featuring 2 sleeping rooms on the floor that offer incredibly comfortable King Beds with private bathrooms, the discreet access to the pool area is an additional bonus found in the rear bedroom.The main level of the home is on the second floor, where guests discover a grand, open kitchen and the main living area. The kitchen can seat a combined 20 guests at the formal dining table, kitchen island, and informal dining table without having to separate your group. It comes completely stocked with premium appliances and tools needed for meal preparation. Private Chef recommendations are available upon request. The spacious living area has ample room to gather or watch TV together. There are 3 sleeping rooms on this floor. One features a King Bed and Bath while the next features an entire section of the house dedicated to those that play and run in packs featuring six Bunk Beds (2 trundles included) and 2 Queen Beds. There are 2 bathrooms that are shared between the bedrooms and the hallway.The home also features a 2-story carriage house, which has a King Bedroom on the first floor, with private full bath, There is a sleeper sofa in the living room as well as a full kitchen with a refrigerator, freezer, microwave, stovetop, and oven. There is a high-top table with seating for 4, so guests have space to enjoy a meal in the carriage house as well. The upstairs bedroom has a beautiful view of the ocean with a King Bed and private bath.The fenced-in backyard features a full-sized swimming pool as well as an outdoor fireplace gathering area. With plenty of pool lounges, on-trend teak seating, picnic table and outdoor grill, a return from the beach to your own private enclave means the evening fun is just beginning.Reserve Beach House 44 today! This stunning place won’t be available long!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Living Room: Queen Sleeper SofaSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Twin over Full Bunk Bed and Twin Trundle Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, One Twin over Twin Bunk Bed and Twin Trundle, Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboCARRIAGE HOUSEFIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Living Area: Full Sleeper SofaSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyKindly Note: Garage is not for guest useWeddings are not allowed at this home. body_text_excerpt: Destinations Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Seacrest Beach "BeachHouse44" 44 Brenda Lane Seacrest Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-048746 Bedrooms 7 Beds 11 Sleeps 24 Full Baths 7 Half Baths 0 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Walk to Alys and Rosemary Beach Shopping and Restaurants -Easy Access to New Publix Grocery/Wine (5 min) -Comfortable Parking for 10+ Vehicles -Large Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $50 per day** -WiFi Internet Premium Speed Package -Multiple TVs including Samsung “The Frame” TVs -Advanced Voice Smoke and CO Detection and Alert System -Instant Hot Water System - Pool table - Grill - 6 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: An elegant 7-bedroom, 7-bathroom home with accommodations for 24 guests in the main house and carriage house. Notable features include a private pool, oversized lot, outdoor entertaining area, pool table, multiple living areas, a detached carriage house, and its prime location to the Gulf! Comes standard with 6 adult bikes and a 6 seat Low-Speed Vehicle for personal use. The first floor of the home warmly invites guests inside to the gathering space with a decor and presence curated by a renowned designer for its breathtaking balance of sophistication and coastal modern minimalism. Featuring 2 sleeping rooms on the floor that offer incredibly comfortable King Beds with private bathrooms, the discreet access to the pool area is an additional bonus found in the rear bedroom. The main level of the home is on the second floor, where guests discover a grand, open kitchen and the main living area. The kitchen can seat a combined 20 guests at the formal dining table, kitchen island, and informal dining table without having to separate your group. It comes completely stocked with premium appliances and tools needed for meal preparation. Private Chef recommendations are available upon request. The spacious living area has ample room to gather or watch TV together. There are 3 sleeping rooms on this floor. One features a King Bed and Bath while the next features an entire section of the house dedicated to those that play and run in packs featuring six Bunk Beds (2 trundles included) and 2 Queen Beds. There are 2 bathrooms that are shared between the bedrooms and the hallway. The home also features a 2-story carriage house, which has a King Bedroom on the first floor, with private full bath, There is a sleeper sofa in the living room as well as a full kitchen with a refrigerator, freezer, microwave, stovetop, and oven. There is a high-top table with seating for 4, so guests have space to enjoy a meal in the carriage house as well. The upstairs bedroom has a beautiful view of the ocean with a King Bed and private bath. The fenced-in backyard features a full-sized swimming pool as well as an outdoor fireplace gathering area. With plenty of pool lounges, on-trend teak seating, picnic table and outdoor grill, a return from the beach to your own private enclave means the evening fun is just beginning. Reserve Beach House 44 today! This stunning place won’t be available long!
